items.title: TikTok reports a €5.5 billion contribution to Germany’s economy.
summary: TikTok said a study commissioned from PF Global estimated that the platform contributed €5.5 billion in gross value added to the German economy in 2025 and supported 52,000 jobs.
The company also said the study estimated 420,000 job and apprenticeship discoveries through TikTok.
items.why: The report is a useful signal that discovery platforms are increasingly being assessed not only as media channels, but as channels that connect retail demand, local businesses and talent attraction.

language.example: The campaign translated online interest into qualified candidate applications.
Treat a commissioned study as useful evidence, while checking its methodology and sponsor.
The new fulfilment site is expected to support job creation in the region.

items.title: TikTok Shop UK reports continued growth in LIVE shopping.
summary: TikTok Shop UK said more than 6,000 LIVE Shopping sessions now take place each day and described LIVE as its fastest-growing shoppable format for businesses.
It reported that LIVE sales increased 55% year on year.
items.why: The development highlights a shift from content-led discovery to real-time conversion, requiring retailers to coordinate creator operations, inventory availability and performance measurement more closely.

language.example: The retailer is testing live video as a shoppable format for new product launches.
The team needs a clear path to convert interest into sales during a livestream.
The growth figure is platform-reported and should be read alongside independent data.

items.title: OpenAI expands eligibility for Businesses in ChatGPT.
summary: OpenAI updated the service on 19 November 2026.
E-commerce and online-service businesses outside the United States are now eligible to claim their business and publish Business Agents in ChatGPT.
Verified businesses can manage key information, add product feeds and review aggregated engagement insights.
items.why: For online retailers, conversational discovery may become another channel where product data, availability and brand information need active operational ownership.

language.example: The retailer plans to claim its business before launching a new product feed.
The marketplace must add a product feed with current pricing and availability.
Only verified sellers are eligible to publish a customer-facing agent.

items.title: Northbeam is hiring a contract technical recruiter for e-commerce analytics.
summary: The official listing gives an application deadline of 1 December 2026.
Northbeam is recruiting a Technical Recruiter on a three-to-six-month contract to support its marketing-intelligence platform for e-commerce brands.
The vacancy describes a business that uses AI to help brands operationalise data and turn insights into automated decisions.
items.why: The role shows continuing demand for recruiters who can support data- and AI-oriented growth teams, especially where e-commerce analytics is central to commercial decision-making.

language.example: She will own full-cycle recruiting for data and platform-engineering roles.
The company is trying to operationalise data across its merchandising decisions.
The team opened a contract engagement to cover a temporary hiring surge.
